title: Cleopatra Lived Closer to the Moon Landing Than the Pyramids
description: The Great Pyramid was already ancient history by the time Cleopatra ruled Egypt.

scenes.text: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the first Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
scenes.subject: egypt

scenes.text: The Great Pyramid of Giza was built around two thousand five hundred and sixty BC.
scenes.subject: pyramid

scenes.text: Cleopatra died in thirty BC. That is about two and a half thousand years after the pyramid went up.
The Moon landing came in nineteen sixty nine, about two thousand years after her. So the pyramid was ancient even to her.
History is a lot longer than it feels. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: pyramid
